استبصروا (form X)
# اِسْتَبْصَرُوا (istabṣarū) /is.tab.sˤa.ruː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِسْتَبْصَرَ (istabṣara)
# اِسْتَبْصِرُوا (istabṣirū) /is.tab.sˤi.ruː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِسْتَبْصَرَ (istabṣara)
